elements.label: Figure 13
elements.title: Distribution of the Vietnam Labor Force by Level of Education (projected until 2050)
elements.content:
Chart type: line chart
X-axis: Year (2010 to 2050 in 5-year intervals)
Y-axis: Percentage (0% to 60%)
Legend: primary (grey line), secondary (orange line), tertiary (yellow line)

Data points:
- primary / 2010: ≈ 36%
- primary / 2015: ≈ 34%
- primary / 2020: ≈ 32%
- primary / 2025: ≈ 30%
- primary / 2030: ≈ 28%
- primary / 2035: ≈ 27%
- primary / 2040: ≈ 26%
- primary / 2045: ≈ 25%
- primary / 2050: ≈ 24%
- secondary / 2010: ≈ 53%
- secondary / 2015: ≈ 52%
- secondary / 2020: ≈ 53%
- secondary / 2025: ≈ 53.5%
- secondary / 2030: ≈ 54%
- secondary / 2035: ≈ 54.5%
- secondary / 2040: ≈ 55%
- secondary / 2045: ≈ 55.5%
- secondary / 2050: ≈ 56%
- tertiary / 2010: ≈ 8%
- tertiary / 2015: ≈ 11%
- tertiary / 2020: ≈ 12%
- tertiary / 2025: ≈ 12.5%
- tertiary / 2030: ≈ 13%
- tertiary / 2035: ≈ 13.5%
- tertiary / 2040: ≈ 14%
- tertiary / 2045: ≈ 14.5%
- tertiary / 2050: ≈ 15%

Source: World Bank (2018b). Vietnam Future Jobs Report (2018).

Key comparisons:
- Secondary education represents the largest share of the labor force throughout the entire projection period, consistently exceeding 50%.
- Primary education steadily declines from approximately 36% in 2010 to 24% by 2050.
- Tertiary education remains the smallest component across all years, increasing only marginally from around 8% in 2010 to about 15% in 2050.
